learning_outcomes.text: Solves convective heat transfer in external flow.
Solves convective heat transfer in internal flow.
Solves heat transfer in natural convection.
Solves heat transfer in boiling and condensation.
Performs thermal calculations of heat exchangers.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to convection, physical mechanism and classification
Velocity and thermal boundary layers, convection equations on flat plates
Introduction to forced external convection, friction and pressure drag in parallel flow over flat plates, cross flow over cylinders, spheres and tube bundles
Introduction to forced internal convection, laminar flow in pipes, application solution
Laminar and turbulent flow in pipes
Introduction to and analysis of Heat Exchangers
Introduction to Heat Radiation, radiation properties, view (shape) factor
Net radiation heat transfer, gas radiation, heat transfer in living organisms, application solution
bibliography: Heat and Mass Transfer, Y. Çengel
Isı ve Kütle Geçişinin Temelleri, Incorpera-DeWitt
Çözümlü (ısı iletimi-ısı taşınımı-ısı ışınımı) Problemleri, O. F. Genceli.
